basic_info.description: Sophisticated condo with incredible views at The Portside, one of San Francisco's most recognizable Art Deco-inspired buildings along the Embarcadero. This junior one-bedroom, one-bath residence offers a refined city lifestyle with timeless design and sweeping views. A signature curvilinear bay window frames light-filled vistas of the Bay, the Bridge, and the pool below, creating a dramatic backdrop for the open living and dining area. Recently refreshed with polished concrete floors, new paint, beautifully remodeled bath, and updated kitchen lighting. In-unit washer/dryer and one-car parking add convenience. Residents enjoy resort-style amenities: two fitness centers, spa, and sun-drenched pool overlooking the Embarcadero, with onsite professional management for a seamless experience. Prime South Beach location steps from the Ferry Building, Oracle Park, Chase Center, South Park, Downtown, plus celebrated dining and cafes. Excellent transit and freeway access ensure easy commuting. A true San Francisco landmark where architectural character meets modern comfort, all at the water's edge.
